SNACS v2.6 annotation notes from authorized guidelines and all 64 purchased review examples. Each target receives [scene role, lexical function], with p. prefixes. Scene role is the relation in context; function is the marker's conventional relation. Preserve divergence. Constraints: p.Participant and p.Configuration are abstract; p.Content is not used for English. p.Experiencer, p.Stimulus, p.Originator, p.Recipient, p.SocialRel, p.Org, p.OrgMember, p.Ensemble, p.QuantityValue cannot be lexical functions. Possessive pronouns and 's have function p.Gestalt, or p.Possessor for canonical possession. Passive by has function p.Agent, p.Force, or p.Causer. Ordinary temporal prepositions use temporal functions, never spatial p.Locus/p.Path/p.Extent merely through metaphor.

Movement/location: go/come/return to a place/person [p.Goal,p.Goal], but go to school as institution attended [p.Org,p.Goal] (reviews-247226-0002). Come to my house, go to PA/surgeon, return to it, go to Kobeys: Goal/Goal (reviews-361316-0002, reviews-148971-0015, reviews-009596-0004, reviews-154157-0002). Typo 'go the the bus boys station': second 'the' Goal/Goal (reviews-010433-0005). at/on/in for physical site, street, highway, container, restaurant, book/show in which something is described: Locus/Locus (reviews-128168-0002, reviews-349020-0003, reviews-116821-0008, reviews-101972-0002, reviews-090136-0006). 'All over my hair' Locus/Locus (reviews-018465-0008); 'in town' Locus/Locus (reviews-299148-0005). 'at the kennels' for organization [p.Org,p.Locus]; 'at Decor and You' for employer [p.Org,p.Locus] (reviews-374604-0001, reviews-229410-0002). 'under glass' Locus/Locus. 'Out of the Wok' and 'from the hood' Source/Source; abstract 'far from perfect' Source/Source (reviews-266591-0002, reviews-330966-0003, reviews-290594-0013). 'round' a route Path/Path (reviews-063963-0003). Directional adverbs 'back', 'in' with movement [p.Direction,p.Direction], including brought clothes in / got them back (reviews-086839-0005, reviews-369087-0009, reviews-361545-0004, reviews-366586-0002); 'in bags' is Locus/Locus (reviews-361545-0004). Metaphorical turn dreams into reality Goal/Goal (reviews-192737-0005).

Possessives/genitives: Owned money, car, dog, apartment, house, bathroom, clothing/uniforms belonging to team: Possessor/Possessor (reviews-165143-0006, reviews-295288-0006, reviews-290594-0013, reviews-389498-0001, reviews-338429-0014, reviews-154157-0002). Agentive 'your contributions', 'her help' [p.Agent,p.Gestalt] (reviews-080221-0004, reviews-062167-0005). 'my dreams' [p.Experiencer,p.Gestalt] (reviews-192737-0005). Body parts and car parts [p.Whole,p.Gestalt] (reviews-018465-0008, reviews-295288-0006). Car's work [p.Theme,p.Gestalt] (reviews-127157-0004). Temporal genitive 'today's tough times' [p.Time,p.Gestalt], 'a year's worth' [p.Duration,p.Gestalt] (reviews-308088-0003, reviews-361545-0004). Relationship my PA, my husband, my child, our team, your server, its client base [p.SocialRel,p.Gestalt] (reviews-148971-0015, reviews-366586-0002, reviews-063963-0003, reviews-154157-0002, reviews-371300-0003, reviews-330966-0003). 'bus boy's station' and generic 'children's clothing' intended for children [p.Beneficiary,p.Possessor] (reviews-010433-0005, reviews-240287-0002). 'whose name' [p.Gestalt,p.Gestalt] (reviews-374604-0001). Guidelines: s-genitive functions always Gestalt or Possessor; of-genitive can directly have Whole, Source, Theme, etc.

Quantity/composition/taxonomy: 'Each of you', 'one of them', 'most of the way' [p.QuantityItem,p.Whole] (reviews-080221-0004, reviews-290594-0013, reviews-063963-0003). 'Plenty/lots of options/restaurants' and 'year's worth of dirty clothes' [p.QuantityItem,p.QuantityItem] (reviews-121342-0003, reviews-090136-0006, reviews-361545-0004). 'batch of wings' [p.QuantityItem,p.Stuff] (reviews-294081-0013); 'piece of metal' [p.Stuff,p.Stuff] (reviews-345182-0007). 'kind of space' [p.Species,p.Species] (reviews-299148-0005). 'member of staff' [p.Org,p.Whole] (reviews-374604-0001). 'sold by the slice' [p.SetIteration,p.SetIteration] (reviews-116821-0008).

Topic, emotion, people: 'proud of contributions', 'pleased/happier with X' [p.Stimulus,p.Topic] (reviews-080221-0004, reviews-255261-0008, reviews-341397-0004). 'Important to them' [p.Experiencer,p.Goal] (reviews-122270-0004). 'Responded to questions' [p.Topic,p.Goal] (reviews-313825-0005). 'Problem with tile', 'argue with that', 'plunge with Stuart', 'know about bull fighting', 'looking/ask for X', 'work on gate', 'maintenance on car' [p.Topic,p.Topic] or [p.Theme,p.Theme] by predicate: problem/argue/about/plunge -> Topic; looking for, ask for, work on, maintenance on -> Theme (reviews-190256-0002, reviews-385281-0008, reviews-278775-0002, reviews-149741-0001, reviews-299148-0005, reviews-371300-0003, reviews-361316-0002, reviews-389498-0001). 'spoke to' and 'recommend to' person [p.Recipient,p.Goal]; passive 'spoken to by member' by=[p.Originator,p.Agent] (reviews-374604-0001). Buying from Edmark [p.Originator,p.Source] (reviews-346627-0002). 'Work with Ted' [p.SocialRel,p.Ancillary]; 'easy to work with' [p.Agent,p.Ancillary] (reviews-229410-0002, reviews-029218-0005). 'Condescending to someone' [p.Beneficiary,p.Goal] (reviews-365154-0007).

Purpose/benefit/manner: Infinitival to when intended outcome, including to get napkins, to suit me, to make do, to keep takeout warm, room to do 5000, is [p.Purpose,p.Purpose] (reviews-010433-0005, reviews-122270-0004, reviews-345182-0007, reviews-231203-0008, reviews-004940-0011). 'for service/remodel/earrings/home' similarly Purpose/Purpose (reviews-369087-0009, reviews-376503-0001, reviews-377347-0004, reviews-192737-0005). 'for picky eaters', 'nothing for you', 'pictures he took for us' [p.Beneficiary,p.Beneficiary] (reviews-121342-0003, reviews-148971-0015, reviews-128636-0005). 'Pay 40 dollars for a onesie' [p.Possession,p.Theme] (reviews-240287-0002). 'Start out by saying' [p.Means,p.Means] (reviews-128168-0002). 'Walk out with crap on hair' [p.Characteristic,p.Characteristic] (reviews-018465-0008); presentational 'with pizzas sitting under glass' [p.Circumstance,p.Circumstance] (reviews-116821-0008). 'On a whim' [p.Explanation,p.Manner], 'as long as' conditional [p.Circumstance,p.Circumstance] (reviews-366586-0002, reviews-127157-0004). 'since' causal Explanation/Explanation but temporal Time/Time, depending context (reviews-209465-0006, reviews-345182-0007, reviews-351727-0005). 'after the way I was spoken to' causal [p.Explanation,p.Time] (reviews-374604-0001).

Time/degree/comparison: 'throughout the year', 'for over a year', 'for quite some time', 'in no time' [p.Duration,p.Duration] for duration marker (reviews-080221-0004, reviews-047184-0005, reviews-278775-0002, reviews-361316-0002). 'over' or 'just about' quantity bounds, 'less than' [p.Approximator,p.Approximator] (reviews-248124-0002, reviews-063963-0003, reviews-361545-0004, reviews-086839-0005). 'on Saturday', 'in today's tough times', 'by this point', 'before' [p.Time,p.Time] (reviews-154157-0002, reviews-308088-0003, reviews-039383-0005, reviews-090136-0006). 'At least', 'at best', 'on all levels' [p.Extent,p.Extent] (reviews-290594-0013, reviews-231203-0008, reviews-292997-0001). In as-as comparative, first as marks role according to phrase but function p.Extent; 'twice as much' involving spending [p.Cost,p.Extent]; second as [p.ComparisonRef,p.ComparisonRef] (reviews-010820-0009). 'Much for daycare' [p.ComparisonRef,p.Purpose] (reviews-290594-0013). 'A heart surgeon like him' [p.Identity,p.ComparisonRef]; 'it's like driving a new car' [p.ComparisonRef,p.ComparisonRef]; 'feel like you are important' [p.Manner,p.ComparisonRef] (reviews-148971-0015, reviews-295288-0006, reviews-288163-0004). 'as a gift/member/decent experience' [p.Identity,p.Identity]; 'comes across as rude' [p.Characteristic,p.Identity] (reviews-311987-0002, reviews-023620-0006, reviews-229410-0002, reviews-351727-0005). 'job of taking care of' [p.Identity,p.Identity] (reviews-389498-0001). 'best in service' [p.Circumstance,p.Circumstance] (reviews-008585-0001).
